newsitem.title: USA: Spice Entertainment to refinance credit.
newsitem.headline: Spice Entertainment to refinance credit.

text.p: Spice Entertainment Cos Inc said Monday it had reached an agreement with its bank to refinance its credit facility.
Howard Glassroth, a company spokesman, said the credit facility's principle balance as of September 30 was $14.6 million.
The company defaulted on certain unspecified covenants as part of the credit. As part of the refinancing agreement, the bank has waived those violations.
The company has a commitment from a third, undisclosed party to receive new financing, which would essentially replace the bank credit facility, Glassroth said.
The company said it expects to complete the refinancing by January 15. The bank has agreed to extend the terms of the existing credit facility until January 15, it said.
Spice Entertainment, formerly known as Graff Pay-Per-View Inc, provides adult television entertainment.
